The second was that he must also have reason to believe that such under-assessment had occurred by reason of either  1  omission or failure on the part of an assessee to make a return of his income under section 22, or  2  omission or failure on the part of an assessee to disclose fully and truly all material facts necessary for his assessment for that year.
